name: Overhead Squat
purpose: General movement screen for mobility, stability, and compensation.

name: Hands-Behind-Head Squat
purpose: Progress overhead squat to determine if compensation may be upper-body related.
interpretation: If squat improves with hands behind head, upper body may contribute to overhead restriction.

name: Latissimus Dorsi Tightness Test
purpose: Check if tight lats contribute to arms falling forward.
setup: Stand against wall in quarter squat, elbows straight, thumbs out, lower back against wall; raise arms overhead.

name: Heels-Raised Overhead Squat
purpose: Determine whether squat improves when heels are raised, suggesting lower-body restriction.
interpretation: Improvement suggests ankle/calf or lower-body mobility limit.

name: Ankle Range of Motion Test
setup: Tape 4 inches from box; half kneeling; toe at tape; knee touches box without heel rising.

name: Thomas Test
purpose: Assess hip flexor and quadriceps tightness.
faults: tested thigh lifts off table = possible iliopsoas tightness
knee cannot flex at least 90 degrees = possible quad tightness

name: Glute Bridge With Leg Extension
purpose: Assess pelvic stability and glute function.

name: Shoulder Mobility Test
pass: Fists within 1.5 hand lengths with no pain.

name: Shoulder Clearance Test
purpose: Check for pain or possible shoulder impingement sign.
setup: Palm on opposite shoulder; lift elbow while maintaining contact.
referral_trigger: Pain means refer to physiotherapist/medical professional.
